selection_rule: Count unique scored-edge rows incident to each bank (from_bank == bank_id or to_bank == bank_id); sort visible_edge_count descending then bank_id ascending; survey the first N banks.
visible_edge_selection_rule: Count unique scored-edge rows incident to each bank; sort count descending, then bank_id ascending; take first N.
seed_edge_selection_rule: Count unique scored-edge rows incident to each bank with score_raw > active seed_score_cutoff; sort count descending, then bank_id ascending; take first N.
total_member_accounts_definition: number of unique account IDs across the bank's rings
share_ring_edges_cross_bank_definition: cross-bank member-edge appearances divided by all member-edge appearances; an edge repeated across rings is counted once per ring
